label: D1 after a rewarded rare transition from a1 (a1 -> S2 rewarded), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), almost only when reward is shown (99% of mass at in_rew=1). Its main trigger is the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) and rewarded, which is the classic model-based switch-to-a2 case. Without any time condition this predicate gets dev F1 0.58 (precision 0.51, mass recall 0.78). The feature is also strongly gated by episode time: it is silent before about trial 35 and after about trial 90, and adding 40 <= ep_trial < 90 raises dev precision to 0.90 and F1 to 0.75. Activations are larger inside the predicate (it covers 87% of the top quartile vs 29% of the bottom quartile). Misses are weak activations after other rewarded trials (for example a2 -> S2 common rewarded) and D1 steps on the first trial of the window, where the previous trial is unknown. Every variable used is observed at D1, so uses_future is false.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r, a1 S2 u) and trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a1 S1 r, a1 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=7, phase=D1 & ep_dec=6, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8.
